verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents a public REST API with API-key auth and a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 spec with 84 paths. It also ships a built-in MCP server that it claims 'drives the whole platform', including building flows, managing tables and testing automations. Nothing explicitly states or demonstrates full UI-to-API parity, and API keys are limited to the Platform and Enterprise editions. Missing for 10: an explicit or verified statement of UI/API parity, API access on all editions, independent hands-on corroboration of API coverage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The API uses "API keys" to authenticate requests.
Activepieces publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1.0 document (84 paths, server https://cloud.activepieces.com/api)
Connect Claude, Cursor, Codex or any MCP client and it drives the whole platform.
Activepieces includes a built-in MCP server that lets AI assistants build flows, manage tables, test automations, and more
API keys are generated under the platform dashboard at this moment to manage multiple projects
